item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03660","case1_error":"Uses 3 grams per smaller antacid instead of the stated 1 gram, inflating their total weight.","case2_error":"Evaluates 10 × 365 × 3 as 109,500 instead of 10,950.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes an incorrect given weight; case 2 numerically miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03661","case1_error":"Evaluates 57 + 190 + 152 as 309 instead of 399.","case2_error":"Miscounts adults and treats 12 eggs per basket as 12 eggs per person, ignoring the 15 baskets.","reason":"Case 1 is an addition evaluation error; case 2 assigns quantities to incorrect roles and constructs incorrect totals.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03662","case1_error":"Omits subtracting the four cookies Ted eats, reporting the count before his consumption.","case2_error":"Treats five loaves as five days, then incorrectly equates 12 slices per loaf with 12 days per loaf.","reason":"Case 1 omits a required consumption deduction; case 2 confuses quantities and units in calculating duration.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03663","case1_error":"Equates current practice P with past practice P/2, then asserts x = 2 without valid derivation.","case2_error":"Reports loan repayment of $23,000 instead of total car expenditure, omitting the $15,000 paid without borrowing.","reason":"Case 1 uses a false equality and invalid inference; case 2 calculates a different quantity from the requested total cost.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03664","case1_error":"Adds the 21, 4, and 18 books to the stated collection total instead of counting them among donated books.","case2_error":"Evaluates 132 + 35 as 144 instead of 167.","reason":"Case 1 misrepresents the collection and donations; case 2 incorrectly evaluates a correctly formulated sum.","judgment":"different"}]}
